lines.zh: 邦尼没有走动，只是站着
lines.en: Bonnie does not walk; he simply stands.

lines.zh: 它的脚被固定在展示台上
lines.en: Its feet are fixed to the display stand.

lines.zh: 它维持着弹琴的姿势
lines.en: It holds a guitar-playing pose.

lines.zh: 关节锈住，一动也不动
lines.en: Rusted joints, and not a twitch.

lines.zh: 它只是把重心往前倾了一点
lines.en: It only leans a fraction forward.

lines.zh: 它没法迈步，只能原地晃
lines.en: It cannot step, only sway in place.

lines.zh: 舞台边缘是它到过的最远处
lines.en: The stage edge is as far as it goes.

lines.zh: 它拖着没反应的腿站着
lines.en: It stands on legs that will not answer.

lines.zh: 它像被按了暂停
lines.en: It looks like it was paused.

lines.zh: 它的姿势十年没变过
lines.en: Its pose has not changed in years.

lines.zh: 它想动，却只抖了一下
lines.en: It tries to move and only shudders.

lines.zh: 它站在原地，等着什么
lines.en: It stands there, waiting for something.

lines.zh: 邦尼垂着手，头微微歪着
lines.en: Bonnie stands with arms slack, head tilted.

lines.zh: 它的耳朵一只朝上，一只垂下
lines.en: One ear points up; the other droops.

lines.zh: 它的塑料眼珠一动不动
lines.en: Its plastic eyes do not move.

lines.zh: 它的指节在微微发响
lines.en: Its finger joints creak faintly.

lines.zh: 灰尘落在它肩上，很厚
lines.en: Dust lies thick on its shoulders.

lines.zh: 它的下颚松着，露出牙
lines.en: Its jaw hangs loose, teeth showing.

lines.zh: 它怀里的吉他还挂在带子上
lines.en: The guitar still hangs from its strap.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛忽然亮了一下
lines.en: Its eyes flicker on for a moment.

lines.zh: 紫色布料被反复摩过，发亮
lines.en: The purple fabric is worn shiny.

lines.zh: 它安静得让房间更空
lines.en: Its stillness makes the room emptier.

lines.zh: 它的耳朵在天花板灯下投出影
lines.en: Its ears cast shadows in the ceiling light.

lines.zh: 它的头缓慢地偏了半寸
lines.en: Its head tilts half an inch.

lines.zh: 它像在等音乐重新响起
lines.en: It looks like it waits for music.

lines.zh: 它没有呼吸，也没有声音
lines.en: It neither breathes nor sounds.

lines.zh: 邦尼的头转向你，很慢
lines.en: Bonnie's head turns to you, slowly.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛对着你，却不聚焦
lines.en: Its eyes face you without focusing.

lines.zh: 它歪着头，像在辨认
lines.en: It tilts its head as if recognising you.

lines.zh: 它的目光停在你脸上很久
lines.en: Its stare rests on your face a long while.

lines.zh: 它的身体没有转向，头却转了
lines.en: Its body stays; only the head moves.

lines.zh: 它的耳朵朝你的方向倾了一下
lines.en: An ear leans toward you.

lines.zh: 它把吉他抱得更紧
lines.en: It pulls the guitar closer.

lines.zh: 它站在台上，你站在台下
lines.en: It stands on stage; you stand below.

lines.zh: 它的影子把你的脚盖住了
lines.en: Its shadow covers your feet.

lines.zh: 它张了张嘴，没有声音
lines.en: Its mouth opens; no sound comes.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，像在等你上台
lines.en: It stares as if waiting for you to step up.

lines.zh: 它没有恶意，只是被设定成这样
lines.en: No malice, only programming.

lines.zh: 它慢慢把头摆正
lines.en: It slowly levels its head.

lines.zh: 它的视线落到你身后的门
lines.en: Its gaze shifts to the door behind you.

lines.zh: 它像在确认门有没有关
lines.en: It seems to check that the door is shut.

lines.zh: 它退不进幕后，也不能前进
lines.en: It can retreat nowhere, advance nowhere.

lines.zh: 它在你身上停留了三秒
lines.en: It holds on you for three seconds.

lines.zh: 然后它又恢复了原来的姿态
lines.en: Then it returns to its original pose.

lines.zh: 邦尼被击中，晃了一下
lines.en: Bonnie takes the hit and rocks.

lines.zh: 它的外壳裂开一道缝
lines.en: A crack opens in its casing.

lines.zh: 里面的骨架露了出来
lines.en: The frame inside shows through.

lines.zh: 它的耳朵歪到一边
lines.en: One ear hangs crooked.

lines.zh: 它退不了，只能原地抖
lines.en: It cannot retreat; it only shudders.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪了两下
lines.en: Its eyes flicker twice.

lines.zh: 它的动作卡住了一瞬
lines.en: Its motion seizes for an instant.

lines.zh: 螺丝从它肩头掉了下来
lines.en: A screw drops from its shoulder.

lines.zh: 它的下颚松得更厉害了
lines.en: Its jaw hangs looser.

lines.zh: 它慢慢把头摆正，继续站着
lines.en: It levels its head and keeps standing.

lines.zh: 邦尼低头看着你手里的东西
lines.en: Bonnie looks down at what you hold.

lines.zh: 它伸出手，动作很僵硬
lines.en: It reaches out in stiff increments.

lines.zh: 它的手指合拢，抓住了
lines.en: Its fingers close and grip.

lines.zh: 它把东西举到眼前，停住
lines.en: It lifts it to eye level and stops.

lines.zh: 它没有嘴可以吃，只能看
lines.en: It has no mouth to eat with, only to look.

lines.zh: 它把东西收进胸前的壳里
lines.en: It stows it behind its chest panel.

lines.zh: 它的耳朵动了一下，算是高兴
lines.en: An ear twitches; that counts as pleased.

lines.zh: 它又把手伸出来要第二个
lines.en: It puts the hand out for another.

lines.zh: 它抱着东西不放，很固执
lines.en: It hugs the item and will not let go.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛亮了一挡
lines.en: Its eyes brighten a notch.

lines.zh: 你撞上邦尼，硬得像铁架
lines.en: You hit Bonnie like an iron frame.

lines.zh: 它被撞得歪了，却没有倒
lines.en: It tips but does not fall.

lines.zh: 它的骨架发出干涩的声音
lines.en: Its frame gives a dry sound.

lines.zh: 它自己慢慢摆回原位
lines.en: It slowly rocks back upright.

lines.zh: 它的手臂挡在过道上
lines.en: Its arm blocks the walkway.

lines.zh: 你只能从它侧身挤过去
lines.en: You have to squeeze past its side.

lines.zh: 它的头随碰撞轻轻晃
lines.en: Its head wobbles with the knock.

lines.zh: 灰从它肩上落下来
lines.en: Dust falls from its shoulder.

lines.zh: 它没有退，也没有追
lines.en: It neither retreats nor pursues.

lines.zh: 它继续站着，像什么都没发生
lines.en: It keeps standing as if nothing happened.

lines.zh: 邦尼和另一具玩偶并排立着
lines.en: Bonnie stands beside another animatronic.

lines.zh: 它们都朝着舞台中央
lines.en: Both face the centre of the stage.

lines.zh: 两只头一起微微歪着
lines.en: Two heads tilt the same way.

lines.zh: 它们的手臂几乎碰到一起
lines.en: Their arms almost touch.

lines.zh: 它们的动作由同一套程序驱动
lines.en: One program drives them both.

lines.zh: 它们的眼睛同时亮起又暗下
lines.en: Their eyes light and dim together.

lines.zh: 灰尘在它们之间积成一线
lines.en: Dust gathers in a line between them.

lines.zh: 它们之间没有交流，只有同步
lines.en: No exchange, only synchrony.

lines.zh: 灯光扫过它们，像在检阅
lines.en: The light sweeps them like an inspection.

lines.zh: 它们就那样站了一整夜
lines.en: They stand like that all night.

lines.zh: 邦尼弯下腰，关节响了一声
lines.en: Bonnie bends; a joint clicks.

lines.zh: 它的手臂卡在半空，停住了
lines.en: Its arm jams halfway and stops.

lines.zh: 它用两根手指夹起东西
lines.en: Two fingers pinch the item up.

lines.zh: 它把东西塞进吉他的音孔
lines.en: It stuffs the item into the guitar's sound hole.

lines.zh: 它仔细地摆正，像在布置
lines.en: It sets it straight, as if decorating.

lines.zh: 它把东西放在脚边，不再碰
lines.en: It leaves it at its feet and forgets it.

lines.zh: 它抬起手，动作慢了半拍
lines.en: Its hand rises half a beat late.

lines.zh: 它把捡到的东西藏在背后
lines.en: It hides what it found behind itself.

lines.zh: 它低头看着空空的掌心
lines.en: It looks at its empty palm.

lines.zh: 它的手停在原处，没有收回
lines.en: Its hand stays where it is.

lines.zh: 邦尼的头猛地转了过来
lines.en: Bonnie's head snaps around.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛全亮了
lines.en: Its eyes come fully alight.

lines.zh: 它抬手，握紧了吉他
lines.en: It raises a hand and grips the guitar.

lines.zh: 骨架里传出一阵急促的响
lines.en: A rapid rattle runs through its frame.

lines.zh: 它开始朝你的方向倾斜
lines.en: It begins leaning your way.

lines.zh: 它的下颚张开了
lines.en: Its jaw falls open.

lines.zh: 它的动作比平时快了一点
lines.en: Its movements come a shade faster.

lines.zh: 它踏不出那一步，只能僵着
lines.en: It cannot take the step; it only locks up.

lines.zh: 它的目光把你钉在原地
lines.en: Its stare pins you where you stand.

lines.zh: 它的耳朵朝前竖起
lines.en: Its ears rake forward.

lines.zh: 它的身体晃了两下
lines.en: Its body sways twice.

lines.zh: 演出时间到了
lines.en: Showtime has arrived.

lines.zh: 它把吉他举了起来
lines.en: It lifts the guitar.

lines.zh: 它的关节开始不合节奏地抽动
lines.en: Its joints begin to jerk out of rhythm.

lines.zh: 它记住你站在哪块地板上
lines.en: It logs which floorboard you stand on.

lines.zh: 它停在那里，等一个信号
lines.en: It stops, waiting for a cue.

lines.zh: 邦尼一直保持朝向你的角度
lines.en: Bonnie keeps its angle fixed on you.

lines.zh: 它歪着头，慢慢调整视线
lines.en: It tilts its head, adjusting its sight.

lines.zh: 它把身体朝前压了一点
lines.en: It presses its body a little forward.

lines.zh: 它的手臂在慢慢抬起
lines.en: Its arm is rising, slowly.

lines.zh: 它的脚步始终没有迈出
lines.en: Its feet never take a step.

lines.zh: 它在等舞台下的你走上来
lines.en: It waits for you to come up.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛一明一暗
lines.en: Its eyes pulse between bright and dim.

lines.zh: 它的头随你左右移动
lines.en: Its head tracks you side to side.

lines.zh: 灯光从它背后照过来
lines.en: The light comes from behind it.

lines.zh: 它的影子一直在你脚边
lines.en: Its shadow stays at your feet.

lines.zh: 它试着往前，肩却顶住了墙
lines.en: It tries forward and its shoulder hits the wall.

lines.zh: 它的架子发出抗议的声音
lines.en: Its frame protests the strain.

lines.zh: 它的视线没离开过一瞬
lines.en: Its gaze has not left for an instant.

lines.zh: 它的姿态越来越向前
lines.en: Its posture keeps leaning nearer.

lines.zh: 它看起来下一秒就会下来
lines.en: It looks a second from stepping down.

lines.zh: 但它还是站在那里
lines.en: And yet it stays where it is.

lines.zh: 它的耳朵慢慢垂了下去
lines.en: Its ears slowly sag.

lines.zh: 它的注意力一点点收回到你身上
lines.en: Its focus narrows down to you.

lines.zh: 邦尼挥来一记僵硬的横打
lines.en: Bonnie swings a stiff, flat blow.

lines.zh: 它的手肘砸在你的护甲上
lines.en: Its elbow clangs on your armour.

lines.zh: 它把吉他抡了过来
lines.en: It swings the guitar around.

lines.zh: 它抓向你的衣领
lines.en: It grabs for your collar.

lines.zh: 它的手指刮过你的手臂
lines.en: Its fingers rake your arm.

lines.zh: 它张着嘴凑到你面前
lines.en: It brings its open jaw to your face.

lines.zh: 它抬脚，却只踢到空气
lines.en: It lifts a foot and kicks only air.

lines.zh: 它的动作不像活物
lines.en: Its motion is nothing like a living thing.

lines.zh: 打完它停在半途，卡住了
lines.en: The strike halts halfway, jammed.

lines.zh: 它把自己带着往前倾
lines.en: It throws its weight behind the blow.

lines.zh: 它的手拍下来，声音很闷
lines.en: Its hand comes down with a dull clap.

lines.zh: 它的关节在用力时咯咯响
lines.en: Joints grind under the effort.

lines.zh: 它想再打一次，手臂没抬起来
lines.en: It tries again; the arm will not lift.

lines.zh: 它退了半步，重新站定
lines.en: It backs half a step and resets.

lines.zh: 它把整条手臂甩了过来
lines.en: It swings the whole arm across.

lines.zh: 它的巴掌拍在你肩上
lines.en: Its hand slaps your shoulder.

lines.zh: 舞台的灯忽然亮起来
lines.en: The stage lights come on.

lines.zh: 邦尼站在聚光灯下
lines.en: Bonnie stands in the spotlight.

lines.zh: 它的影子投在幕布上
lines.en: Its shadow falls on the curtain.

lines.zh: 灰尘在光柱里翻滚
lines.en: Dust turns in the beam.

lines.zh: 它被摆在原来的位置上
lines.en: It has been placed back in its spot.

lines.zh: 它的吉他还挂在身上
lines.en: The guitar still hangs on it.

lines.zh: 它的头慢慢抬起
lines.en: Its head lifts slowly.

lines.zh: 扬声器里先响了一声杂音
lines.en: First a crackle from the speaker.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛亮起两点紫光
lines.en: Two purple points light in its eyes.

lines.zh: 它的关节一节节归位
lines.en: Its joints settle one by one.

lines.zh: 它身上的灰落了一地
lines.en: Dust falls off it in sheets.

lines.zh: 它站在那里，像从来没离开
lines.en: It stands as if it never left.

lines.zh: 地板被它压得轻响
lines.en: The floor creaks under it.

lines.zh: 它转向观众席的方向
lines.en: It turns toward the seats.

lines.zh: 幕布后传来一点动静
lines.en: Something stirs behind the curtain.

lines.zh: 它先动的是耳朵
lines.en: Its ears move first.

lines.zh: 它把吉他从肩上取下
lines.en: It lifts the guitar from its shoulder.

lines.zh: 然后它就不动了
lines.en: And then it does not move.

lines.zh: 布料烧起来，它却没有躲
lines.en: The fabric burns and it does not flinch.

lines.zh: 倒下时它砸在地上，起不来
lines.en: It crashes down and cannot get up.

lines.zh: 水灌进外壳，它的灯灭了
lines.en: Water fills the casing and its lights die.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀飞了它半边外壳
lines.en: The blast tears away half its shell.

lines.zh: 箭插进它的胸口，晃了晃
lines.en: An arrow sticks in its chest and quivers.

lines.zh: 怪力让它全身抽了一下
lines.en: Odd force makes it convulse once.

lines.zh: 它不需要吃，但电池空了
lines.en: It does not eat, but its battery is empty.

lines.zh: 雷击让它原地跳了一下
lines.en: Lightning makes it jump in place.

lines.zh: 虚空拽住它，它抓不住任何东西
lines.en: The void pulls and it has nothing to grip.
